directionSent: deep, resonant, booming, noble and ancient
heardByWhisper: As you enter the cave, you are greeted by Diogenes, the Silver Dragon.  He says, I see you have recovered the silver bottle from the Cobold Caves.  I congratulate you.  That bottle contains a powerful efreet who was summoned to kill vampires.  He will be a valuable ally in old Flan.  In Valhingan graveyard, there is a vampire.  When you meet the vampire, use the bottle and you may have a chance in defeating him.  I wish you luck.  After speaking, Diogenes flies through a hole in the ceiling and disappears.
